name: kamisado
description: Kamisado with ten-level classical AI, real-time multiplayer, sumo mechanics, and chess-style timers

scripts.test:unit: tsx tests/unit/test_game_features.ts && tsx tests/unit/test_sumo.ts && tsx tests/unit/test_rules_comprehensive.ts && tsx tests/unit/test_ai_engine.ts && tsx tests/unit/test_ai_runner.ts && tsx tests/unit/test_timer.ts && tsx tests/unit/test_connectivity.ts && tsx tests/unit/test_invitation_url.ts && tsx tests/unit/test_peer_network.ts && tsx tests/unit/test_automatic_invitation.ts && node --test tests/unit/test_desktop_artifacts.cjs && tsx tests/unit/test_token_vault.ts && tsx tests/unit/test_server_lifecycle.ts && tsx tests/unit/test_hosting_controller.ts
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node tests/browser/test_board_views.cjs && node tests/browser/test_invitation_flow.cjs && node tests/browser/test_ai_games.cjs && node tests/browser/test_desktop_launcher.cjs && node tests/browser/test_p2p_transport.cjs && node tests/browser/test_p2p_games.cjs && npm run mobile:build && node tests/browser/test_quick_join.cjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:p2p-relay: npm run build && npm run mobile:build && node tests/browser/test_p2p_relay.cjs && node tests/browser/test_quick_join.cjs
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
scripts.test:mobile: npm run build && npm run mobile:build && node tests/browser/test_mobile.cjs
